summary: This RFC defines TLVs for carrying cryptographic integrity check values, such as signatures or message authentication codes, and timestamps in the generalized MANET packet and message format of RFC 5444. It was replaced by RFC 7182.

eli5.summary: A message can carry a sealed stamp proving it was not changed, plus a clock reading. This defined where to put those on wireless mesh messages.

questions: how to add integrity check values to manet packets
what is the manet timestamp tlv
